properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 8 at 4:17PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 417 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of showers extending
from 11 miles south of Prospect Valley to near Aurora, or extending
from 34 miles northeast of Denver to 11 miles east of Denver, moving
south at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Aurora, Bennett, Manila Village, Watkins and Buckley SFB.
properties.areaDesc: North Douglas County Below 6000 Feet/Denver/West Adams and Arapahoe Counties/East Broomfield County; Central and East Adams and Arapahoe Counties

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 8 at 4:05PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 405 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from 5 miles northwest of Logan Corners to
near Goodrich, or extending from 12 miles west of Sterling to 14
miles northwest of Fort Morgan, moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and half inch size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Southwestern Sterling, Fort Morgan, Brush, Log Lane Village,
Merino, Hillrose, Antelope Springs, Snyder, Willard, Pawnee Pass,
Prewitt Reservoir, Weldona, Logan Corners, Atwood, Goodrich,
Jackson Reservoir, Union, Fort Morgan Airport and Messex.
properties.areaDesc: Morgan County; Logan County; Washington County

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 8 at 4:03PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 400 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a thunderstorm producing a
landspout 12 miles north of Hartman, or 18 miles northwest of
Coolidge, moving south at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and potential for a brief
gustnado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible. Gusty winds
could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured
objects.

Locations impacted include...
Holly, Granada, Hartman, and Bristol.
properties.areaDesc: Eastern Kiowa County; Lamar Vicinity/Prowers County
